title: Conditions and Competent Authority for Employee Transfer
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: No automatic transfer
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that transfer does not happen automatically upon approval of the job classification table. FAIL if the note does not state this, or states or implies that transfer occurs automatically upon approval of the job classification table.

criteria.title: Competent authority decision required
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a decision from the competent authority (السلطة المختصة) is required to effect the transfer. FAIL if the note does not mention that a decision from the competent authority (السلطة المختصة) is required to effect the transfer.

criteria.title: Employee affairs committee consultation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the matter must be presented to the employee affairs committee (لجنة شئون العاملين) before the transfer decision. FAIL if the note does not mention that the matter must be presented to the employee affairs committee (لجنة شئون العاملين) before the transfer decision.

criteria.title: Conditions for transfer met
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that transfer to the equivalent position is permissible because the grade matches and the employee meets the conditions for occupying it. FAIL if the note does not state that transfer to the equivalent position is permissible because the grade matches and the employee meets the conditions for occupying it.

criteria.title: Placement rules consider qualifications and experience
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that placement rules take into account the employee's qualifications, experience, and other employment circumstances. FAIL if the note does not mention that placement rules take into account the employee's qualifications, experience, and other employment circumstances.

changes: Tightened C-001 FAIL clause to also fail on omission
review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-005 against Law No. 47 of 1978 (Article 54 and Executive Regulations) on Civil Servants in force at the time of Fatwa No. 70 (1997/01/08).
